result.title: A Unified Framework for Image Manipulation Localization Under Multi-Type Weak Supervision
result.summary: Existing weakly supervised image manipulation localization (IML) methods typically rely on annotation-specific training strategies, hindering the joint use of diverse annotations within a single model. This limits the scale of usable training data and constrains further progress. We propose UniIML, a teacher-student framework that maps diverse weak annotations into a unified representation to guide the Segment Anything Model (SAM) in generating multiple candidate masks. However, SAM is designed for general-purpose segmentation and has limited sensitivity to manipulation traces; its predicted quality scores alone may therefore fail to reliably identify the candidate that best delineates the manipulated region. We introduce Ordinal Safe Consensus (OSC), which first filters candidates using trusted weak-annotation constraints encoded in the unified representation. It then ranks the remaining candidates separately by consistency with weak annotations, SAM-predicted quality scores, and cross-view stability, aggregating these rankings for an initial selection. To assess how changes in the evaluation criteria affect candidate selection, OSC repeats ranking and selection while omitting one criterion at a time. The most frequently selected candidate is adopted as the final mask, and its relative selection frequency quantifies selection stability. We construct soft pseudo-labels from the selected candidate's predicted probabilities and estimate pixel-level supervision weights based on selection stability, pixel-level agreement among candidates, and predictive certainty. The student receives direct supervision in regions defined by weak annotations and learns from soft pseudo-labels elsewhere through reliability-weighted distillation, enabling unified training across weak annotation types. Experiments show that UniIML achieves superior average performance compared with state-of-the-art IML methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UniIML 教师—学生框架，把多种弱标注映射为统一表示来引导 SAM 生成候选掩码，再按弱标注一致性、SAM 质量分和跨视角稳定性排序并聚合选出最终掩码，据此构造软伪标签做可靠性加权蒸馏。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多准则一致性排序、留一准则重选与选择频率稳定性，可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 候选假设的筛选与验证可信度估计提供线索，但这是像素级掩码选择，是否可迁移需人工核查。
